name: Scarlet Training turns Argent Blade into Scarlet Hammer (#5162)
contract: Scarlet Training 301065 reads 'Casting Argent Blade while Warrior of Dawn is active now transforms your next Argent Blade into Scarlet Hammer'. Casting Argent Blade (rank 7 807268 here) with Warrior of Dawn 561156 applies Scarlet Crusader 301172, whose apply swaps Argent Blade for Scarlet Hammer 807035. Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement refuses a replacement the player does not know and nothing teaches 807035, so the button never changed. AscensionTemplar::Replacement now lends the replacement spell temporarily while the swap is active and removes that temporary copy when it clears; casting Scarlet Hammer consumes Scarlet Crusader. Divine Fury 563269 swaps Vindication 801446 for Divine Fury 500689 through the same helper and had the same gap.
